serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Landlord: Hmph! You think that’s enough? You: I gave you the money, I apologized, what more do you want? Landlord: ’What more do you want’ he says… Landlord: {{punch}}MORE MONEY OF COURSE! You: I paid on time! Why would I give you more money! Landlord: … Landlord: You might be right, but being right isn’t enough to keep you on my good side. Landlord: I will wait until you really fuck up and I will make an example out of you! Remember that! #Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.5) You: … Well, that went well. I need to remember on which day he comes for money, otherwise this might get ugly for me…
